title_zh: Google Cloud 将 OpenAI GPT-6 系列接入 Model Garden（私有预览）
title_en: Google Cloud brings OpenAI GPT-6 models to Model Garden (private preview)
summary_zh: GCP 宣布在统一企业 AI 平台上提供 GPT-6 Astra / GPT-6.1 Sol / GPT-6 Luna，与 Gemini 等模型并列。能力与计费以 Google Cloud 公告为准。
summary_en: GCP is rolling out GPT-6 Astra, GPT-6.1 Sol, and GPT-6 Luna in Model Garden beside Gemini and 200+ other models. Capabilities and billing: see the Google Cloud post.

title_zh: Anthropic：Claude Haiku 4.5 将退出聊天模型选择器，改推 Haiku 5.5
title_en: Anthropic: Claude Haiku 4.5 leaving chat model selector for Haiku 5.5
summary_zh: 帮助中心说明自 2026-10-29 起 Free/Pro/Max 聊天界面不再展示 Haiku 4.5，改用 Haiku 5.5；API / Claude Code / 团队版仍可继续用 4.5。
summary_en: Help Center: from 2026-10-29 Haiku 4.5 leaves the Free/Pro/Max chat selector in favor of Haiku 5.5; API, Claude Code, and Team/Enterprise keep 4.5.

title_zh: DeepSeek 发布 V4.1-Flash-1017：更快完成任务并开放 Search API
title_en: DeepSeek ships V4.1-Flash-1017 with faster runs and Search API
summary_zh: 官方将 Flash 升级为 1017 快照，强调性能–成本 Pareto；同日开放自研 Search & Fetch API。API 仍用 deepseek-flash，价格以官网为准。
summary_en: DeepSeek upgrades Flash to the 1017 snapshot (performance–cost Pareto) and opens its Search & Fetch APIs. Keep calling deepseek-flash; verify pricing on official docs.

title_zh: Meta 开源 Muse Spark Open：美系开源权重新档，面向智能体与编程
title_en: Meta open-weights Muse Spark Open for agents and coding
summary_zh: Muse Spark Open（约 816B 总参 / 42B 激活，1M 上下文）权重可下载并支持多推理引擎。商用前请阅读 Meta 许可与安全说明。
summary_en: Muse Spark Open (~816B total / 42B active, 1M context) weights are downloadable across major hubs and engines. Read Meta’s license and safety notes before commercial use.

title_zh: Anthropic 发布 Claude Haiku 4.5：更快更省的轻量档
title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 4.5: faster, cheaper light tier
summary_zh: Haiku 4.5 面向高吞吐与低延迟场景，与 Sonnet/Opus 形成产品梯队。定价与限速以 Anthropic 官网为准。
summary_en: Haiku 4.5 targets high-throughput, low-latency workloads alongside Sonnet/Opus. Pricing and rate limits: see Anthropic.

title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 对开发者开放：百万级统一上下文与长解码
title_en: Gemini 4 Argon opens to developers: unified 1M context and long decode
summary_zh: Google 宣布 Argon 可通过付费 Gemini API / AI Studio 使用，面向长程软件工程与知识工作。入门价与后续调价以 Google 定价页为准。
summary_en: Google makes Argon available on the paid Gemini API / AI Studio for long-horizon engineering and knowledge work. Introductory and later prices: see Google’s pricing page.

title_zh: Meta 发布 Muse Wonder / Wonder Full：面向智能体的前沿闭源档
title_en: Meta launches Muse Wonder / Wonder Full frontier agent models
summary_zh: Wonder 经 Meta Model API 与 Muse Code 提供；Wonder Full 目前仅订阅可用。定价示例约 $4/$20 per MTok，请以官方为准。
summary_en: Wonder is on Meta Model API and Muse Code; Wonder Full is subscription-only for now. Listed API pricing around $4/$20 per MTok — confirm on Meta’s pages.

title_zh: OpenAI 平台模型页更新：GPT-4.1 / o 系列入口整理
title_en: OpenAI platform model docs refreshed for GPT-4.1 and o-series
summary_zh: 开发者文档对长上下文与推理模型入口做了梳理。具体能力与价格请核对官方 Models 页。
summary_en: Developer docs reorganized long-context and reasoning model entries. Verify capabilities and prices on the official Models page.

title_zh: 国内生成式 AI：备案与上架仍是产品上线关键路径
title_en: China generative AI: filing and listing remain critical launch paths
summary_zh: 面向中国用户的生成式产品需关注算法备案与应用上架要求。本站仅作信息整理，不构成法律意见。
summary_en: GenAI products for China users should track algorithm filing and app listing rules. This site is informational only, not legal advice.

title_zh: 智谱 GLM-4.5：开源与清言产品线同步强化 Agent
title_en: Zhipu GLM-4.5: open and ChatGLM products lean into agents
summary_zh: 智谱在开源权重与 API 两侧强化工具调用。国内落地可关注合规与私有化方案。
summary_en: Zhipu strengthens tool use on open weights and API. Watch compliance and private-deploy options for China apps.

title_zh: Claude Sonnet 4.5 上线：编程与写作再加强
title_en: Claude Sonnet 4.5 ships with stronger coding and writing
summary_zh: Anthropic 更新 Sonnet 主力档，强调软件工程与长任务表现。对比 Opus 时注意成本差异。
summary_en: Anthropic updates its Sonnet workhorse with emphasis on software engineering and long tasks. Compare cost vs Opus carefully.

title_zh: Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash：百万级上下文多模态继续推进
title_en: Gemini 2.5 Pro / Flash: million-token multimodal continues
summary_zh: Google 在 AI Studio / API 侧持续推送 Gemini 2.5 系列。音视频与超长文档场景可优先试用 Flash 控成本。
summary_en: Google continues Gemini 2.5 via AI Studio / API. Prefer Flash for A/V and huge docs when controlling cost.

title_zh: xAI Grok 与 X 平台：实时信息流继续作为卖点
title_en: xAI Grok and X: realtime firehose remains the pitch
summary_zh: Grok 强调与 X 数据结合的时效性。企业合规与内容审核需求需单独评估。
summary_en: Grok leans on X data freshness. Evaluate enterprise compliance and moderation needs separately.

title_zh: DeepSeek API 与开源权重：V3 / R1 生态持续扩展
title_en: DeepSeek API and open weights: V3 / R1 ecosystem keeps growing
summary_zh: 深度求索的开源与 API 双轨仍被国内团队广泛采用。部署时请核对许可证与商用条款。
summary_en: DeepSeek’s open + API dual track remains popular with CN teams. Check license and commercial terms before deploy.

title_zh: 通义 Qwen3 系列：开源与阿里云商用同步更新
title_en: Qwen3 series: open releases and Alibaba Cloud commercial updates
summary_zh: Qwen 团队在开源仓库与云上 Model Studio 同步迭代。选型时分清开源权重与云端 Max 档。
summary_en: Qwen iterates on GitHub and Alibaba Model Studio together. Separate open weights from cloud Max tiers when choosing.

title_zh: 月之暗面 Kimi K2：开源 MoE 与长上下文产品线
title_en: Moonshot Kimi K2: open MoE and long-context product line
summary_zh: Kimi 产品与 K2 开源权重面向长文与智能体场景。具体参数与许可以官方公告为准。
summary_en: Kimi products and K2 open weights target long-form and agents. Specs and license follow official notices.

title_zh: Meta Llama 4：开源多模态与超长上下文路线图进展
title_en: Meta Llama 4: open multimodal and ultra-long context progress
summary_zh: Llama 4 Maverick / Scout 继续推动自托管与云厂商托管。商用前务必阅读 Llama 社区许可。
summary_en: Llama 4 Maverick / Scout drive self-host and cloud hosting. Read the Llama community license before commercial use.

title_zh: 提醒：各厂商 API 定价频繁调整，请以官网为准
title_en: Reminder: vendor API pricing changes often — check official pages
summary_zh: 本站模型卡中的定价说明仅为提示，不构成报价。采购与核算请直接打开各厂商定价页。
summary_en: Pricing notes on model cards are reminders only, not quotes. Use each vendor’s official pricing page for procurement.
